title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

paper.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
paper.authors: Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, Dominik Lorenz, Patrick Esser, Bjorn Ommer
paper.summary: Runs diffusion in the compressed latent space of an autoencoder and adds text conditioning, making high-resolution generation practical.
